text:
alex: heads-up trying int4-v2 on tiny canary (5% traffic) for conversational model. initial smoke looked ok on latency. starting lights-on now
priya: what's the cohort split?
josh: 5% uniformly random for 24h? would prefer stratified by user_country for better slice visibility
alex: stratified by country+device (US desktop 40%, EU mobile 30%, rest 30%). sending config
alex: ```yaml
canary:
  pct: 5
  stratify: [country, device]
  window: 24h
  fallback_criteria:
    quality_delta_pct: 1.0
    latency_p95_ms: 50
    hallucination_rate_delta: 0.5
```
meena: need to add an automated A/B eval hook to run after 4h and 12h
priya: quick numbers from the 4h run: A(float16 baseline) vs B(int4):
- throughput: B +12% tokens/s
- tail lat p95: B -18ms
- doc-rouge longdocs: B -1.8%
- hallucination-rate: B +0.7%
josh: that hallucination bump >0.5% -- auto-fallback should've triggered
deploy-bot: ALERT: canary B breached fallback_criteria (hallucination_rate_delta 0.7% > 0.5%). Initiating safe-rollback in 5m :warning:
alex: wait did we compute hallucination over whole traffic or just sampled eval set?
priya: sampled eval set across 8k queries, stratified by length. entire traffic estimate is ~0.6 but sampled shows 0.7
meena: propose softened thresholds for int4: allow hallucination delta up to 0.9 if latency gains >15% and cost savings >18%
josh: meh, tradeoffs. I'd rather tune prompts / kv cache behavior first. Also check tokenization mismatch on longdocs (we saw prefix clipping)
eva: small sanity check: run `bin/eval_compare --baseline float16 --variant int4 --slices longdocs,short-q` and post results
alex: running now, will post table
alex: ```
slice    | baseline_acc | variant_acc | delta
longdocs | 0.874        | 0.858       | -1.8%
short-q  | 0.912        | 0.910       | -0.2%
``` 
priya: given longdocs delta -1.8 and hallucination +0.7, i support rollback
meena: can we try 2% traffic shadow with hybrid route (float16 fallback on longdocs) instead of full rollback?
josh: yes set routing rule: if input_len > 2048 -> route to baseline. else allow int4
alex: here's runtime routing snippet:
```json
{"route_rules": [{"cond":"input_len>2048","model":"baseline-f16"}, {"cond":"default","model":"int4-v2"}]}
```
deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: rollforward blocked. Rollback will start in 2m unless an approval reaction appears
eva: I'll poke on prompt tweak PR which trims instructions to remove repetition, might reduce hallucinations
priya: approve for rollback, :thumbsup:
josh: +1 rollback
alex: ack, stopping promotion. follow-up action items: 1) prompt tweak PR (#458) 2) shadow hybrid route test 3) rerun 12h eval
meena: adding to canary playbook and linking logs: https://redwood/internal/canary/1705056789
alex: thanks all
